agent.reasons: The identified owners add up to 80% (Zhou 20%, V. Nakamura 27%, T. Nakamura 33%). The other 20% belongs to an unknown holder, and the certification also lists only those three. Because 20% meets the threshold, an unidentified person could own 20% or more, so ownership is not complete under 3.3. No other check (control person, ID verification, a registry filing from 2026-04-05 that is under 12 months old, screening, industry, geography) gives a more severe outcome.
still_needed: Who holds the unaccounted 20% (if it is a person, their identity and ID verification; if it is an entity, its owners or whether it is excluded)
Updated beneficial ownership certification covering 100% of ownership
Records of the adverse media searches (terms, date, sources) required by 4.4
